text:
Maria: Quick cross-team check-in on the token-cost attribution work — short status, owners, and blockers pls.

Jonah: Schema PRs are ready for review (see https://github.com/redwood/instr/pull/4872 and /pull/4875). Canary plan is set for tomorrow.

Priya: Quick heads-up — analytics needs the final event name/shape before we run the cost join. Right now sample set missing composite key for user+session. Can someone upload a sanitized sample?

Alex: Noted. Also flag: a tiny tokenizer change in the runtime patch means we need a mapping table for older logs -> new token ids. I'll add a migration script but need the final schema field name stable.

Sam: From SRE: will this increase ClickHouse write QPS? If so we need a short retention/partition plan.

Lora: I can provision a new topic + short-term retention. Opening infra ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-992 — will link when done.

Maria: Can we get a concise owners + due dates list here so I can update roadmap?

Jonah: Owners + rough dates:
- Event schema rename & PR: @Jonah -> merge target EOD Wed (1765518500).
- Ingest pipeline (kafka/consumer): @Lora -> infra + config by Thu morning.
- Analytics transform & joins: @Priya -> smoke evals by Fri.
- Runtime mapping + canary: @Alex -> canary tonight, roll if green.

Priya: Blocker: sample dataset. Jonah — can you drop a sanitized sample to s3://redwood-instr/samples/token-attrib/so we can validate joins? Prefer CSV with cols: user_id, session_id, event_time, tokens.

Jonah: Will upload today. temp path: s3://redwood-instr/samples/token-attrib/temp-v1.csv — will post final link after scrub.

Alex: FYI runtime patch 0.12.3 will land in canary today at 20:00 UTC. Migration script in repo: `tools/token-map/migrate_v0_v1.py` — minimal perf impact. :rocket:

Priya: Once Jonah uploads, I'll run quick validation and post results here. If joins fail we'll revert to pre-rename schema in analytics until fix.

Jonah: Please review PRs #4872 and #4875 with :eyes: — they contain the rename + ingest consumer updates. Small config diff: `EVENT_TOKEN_COUNTS -> token_count`.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: 2026-03-18 20:00:00 UTC for service `ingest-consumer` (sha: ab12c3d). Logs will stream to #eng-runtime.

Sam: If canary increases tail latency, auto-fallback -> small-model-path will be enabled. I'll watch the SLO dashboard and ping if we hit 95th pct > 350ms.

Lora: INF-992 created and assigned to me. Will share k8s config and topic retention update by EOD.

Maria: Summary: upload sample (Jonah) -> analytics validation (Priya) -> review & merge PRs (everyone) -> canary (Alex) -> infra configs (Lora) -> SRE monitor (Sam). I'll update the sprint card and follow up on any lingering action items. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Jonah: tagging owners in PRs. Ping me if you need the scrub script.

Priya: I'll post validation snippets here once done.

Maria: Closing this check-in. If anything changes, re-open thread or DM.
